description: A JSON and BSON toolkit for sciBASIC#: a streaming JSON tokenizer and parser, a lenient parser that repairs malformed large language model output, a pretty-print formatter, deep cloning helpers, JSON-RPC 2.0 client and session support, plus BSON binary encoding and object serialization.
releaseNotes: Adds a JSON-RPC 2.0 client with request/response framing and sessions, JSON report export helpers and deep clone support, and rewrites the pretty-print JSON formatter.

title: PDF Document Reader, Text Extractor and Writer Library
description: Reads and writes PDF files for sciBASIC#: a low-level reader resolves xref tables, object streams and filters to extract page text via ToUnicode CMaps, while a streaming generator lays out text, tables and images.
releaseNotes: Adds a PDF report renderer that lays the shared report block model out onto PDF pages.

title: RDF/XML and Turtle Triple Serialization Model
description: Supports the application/rdf+xml MIME type for sciBASIC#: XML serialization models for RDF descriptions, bags and DCMI metadata, plus an RDF 1.1 Turtle parser that streams subject-predicate-object triples and re-materializes them as RDF entities.
releaseNotes: Package maintenance release: build and packaging configuration updates only, no functional changes in this cycle.

title: Rich Text Format Writer, Reader and Office MathML Models
description: Reads and writes rich text format documents for sciBASIC#: RtfDocument implements the shared IDocumentWriter contract to emit RTF 1.x files with headings, tables, images and page setup, RtfTextReader parses .rtf back into text and metadata, plus serializable OMML equation models.
releaseNotes: Adds an RTF report renderer implementing the shared report render contract on top of RtfDocument.

title: XLSX Workbook Reader, Writer and Legacy BIFF Writer
description: XLSX Transitional Office Open XML support for sciBASIC#: reads an xlsx package into typed directory parts, sheets and styles, generates styled workbooks with formulas and number formats, and writes legacy BIFF 2.1 xls files.
releaseNotes: Package maintenance release: build and packaging configuration updates only, no functional changes in this cycle.

title: XML Toolkit with XSD Models, MathML and XPath Queries
description: XML helpers for sciBASIC#: an XSD schema element data model, MathML content markup parsed into expression objects, a lightweight XPath query engine, and a generic XmlElement tree with reflection based object graph loading, plus a code generator.
releaseNotes: Package maintenance release: build and packaging configuration updates only, no functional changes in this cycle.

title: DOCX Word Document Generator and Text Extractor
description: Generates Office Word documents in sciBASIC#: a fluent writer builds document titles, headings H1-H6, paragraphs, tables, images, lists, code blocks and a table of contents, packs them into a .docx package, and extracts plain text back out.
releaseNotes: Adds a DOCX report renderer that writes report blocks as Word documents, together with thesis formatting helpers and OMML equation fixes.

title: XPS / OXPS Document Generator and Text Extractor
description: Generates and reads XPS and OpenXPS fixed-page documents for sciBASIC#: a block based writer lays out text, tables and images onto fixed pages with optional ODTTF font embedding, packs them into an OPC package, extracts plain text back out through the Glyphs content streams, and implements the shared ReportRender contract for report generation.
releaseNotes: Initial release: OpenXPS and Microsoft XPS document writer with automatic line wrapping and pagination, ODTTF font embedding, OPC packaging, Glyphs based text extraction and a report renderer for the shared block model.

title: HTML/CSS Parser, DOM and CSS Style Environment
description: An HTML and CSS toolkit for sciBASIC#: tokenizes HTML into a queryable DOM, parses CSS selectors, rule files and property values into typed models, resolves CSS lengths, fonts and strokes against a canvas style environment, and renders the DOM through a CSS box layout engine.
releaseNotes: Package maintenance release: build and packaging configuration updates only, no functional changes in this cycle.

title: Markdown Parser, Block Model and Multi-Format Renderer
description: A markdown processor for sciBASIC#: a two-phase recursive block and inline parser that renders markdown to HTML or plain text, a typed block model with JSON, HTML and CSS styled renderers, nested table-of-contents generation from ATX headers, and block level conversion for report pipelines.
releaseNotes: Adds a block level markdown parser with heading and table-of-contents extraction, CSS driven style rendering and a markdown-to-blocks converter, plus render tests.

title: YAML to JSON Object Model Parser and Front Matter Reader
description: Parses YAML for the sciBASIC# framework into the JsonElement model with block mappings, sequences, flow collections, block scalars, anchors, aliases and comments, plus a lightweight markdown front-matter reader.
releaseNotes: Extends the front-matter reader and YAML parser for agent-skill style profiles and fixes symbol references.

title: Bipartite Knowledge Graph with Synonym Disambiguation and Ontology Inference
description: Builds and mines bipartite entity-attribute knowledge graphs for sciBASIC#: scores entity pairs with Jaccard, Adamic-Adar and cosine metrics, runs permutation tests to merge synonyms, and infers ontology relations.
releaseNotes: Package maintenance release: build and packaging configuration updates only, no functional changes in this cycle.

title: Natural Language Processing Toolkit: Tokenizers, Stemmer, BM25 and LDA
description: NLP toolkit for sciBASIC#: Chinese word segmentation via max-match, HMM and a HuggingFace-compatible BPE/WordPiece/Unigram pipeline, plus a Porter stemmer, TF-IDF, bigram extraction, BM25 ranked search and Gibbs-sampled LDA topic modeling.
releaseNotes: Optimises the Gibbs-sampled LDA implementation with partitioned sampling and a dedicated random source, and adds a benchmark.

title: Word2Vec Embedding Trainer with Skip-Gram and CBOW
description: Trains word embeddings for sciBASIC#: a multi-threaded Word2Vec using skip-gram and CBOW over Huffman trees, a fluent factory for vector size, window and sampling, plus vector models for similarity and analogy queries.
releaseNotes: Package maintenance release: build and packaging configuration updates only, no functional changes in this cycle.

title: 2D and 3D Rigid Body Physics Engine with Joints, Fields and Fluids
description: A fixed-step rigid body physics engine for sciBASIC#: two and three dimensional worlds with broad and narrow phase collision detection, SAT based convex polyhedron contacts and manifolds, revolute, prismatic, spring, weld, ball and hinge joints, angular motors, gravity / wind / magnetic force fields, plus SPH fluid and boids hooks for particle scenes.
releaseNotes: Adds a three dimensional physics world with SAT based convex polyhedron collision, contact manifolds and sequential impulse solvers, ball / hinge joints and angular motors, while keeping the two dimensional world, force fields and particle hooks.

title: 3D SPH Fluid and Boids Flocking Particle Engine
description: Particle simulation for sciBASIC#: a Structure-of-Arrays 3D SPH fluid solver with box, cylinder and impeller boundaries and a pluggable compute backend, uniform-grid neighbour search, three dimensional boids flocking kernels, a pooled 2D particle system with emitters, and force driven label placement layouts.
releaseNotes: Initial release: three dimensional SPH fluid engine with box, cylindrical and rotating impeller boundaries, a pluggable parallel compute backend, 3D boids flocking kernels and grid, plus the pooled 2D particle system and force layout helpers.

title: Visual Studio Solution, VBProject And Source Code Analysis Toolkit
description: Parses and writes .sln/.slnx solutions and .vbproj files, builds VB.NET symbol trees with a recursive descent parser, maps compiled assemblies by metadata reflection, decodes IL into syntax trees and resolves source maps for sciBASIC# code tooling.

title: PDB Debug Symbol File Reader For Classic And Portable Formats

releaseNotes: Package maintenance release: build and packaging configuration updates only, no functional changes in this cycle.

title: JavaScript Parser, Interpreter and VB.NET Code Generator
description: A lightweight JavaScript engine for sciBASIC#: lexes and parses JS source into an AST, runs it on a tree-walking interpreter with classes, promises, generators, async functions and source level stack traces, provides console, filesystem, path, buffer and process modules plus CLR interop, ships an interactive REPL and transpiles programs into standalone VB.NET classes.
releaseNotes: Turns the engine into a usable runtime: adds an interactive REPL, JS source level stack traces and error objects, console with ANSI/HTML rendering, filesystem, path, buffer and process modules, CLR interop, class and accessor semantics, promises, generators and async/await, plus function value reflection.
